author: ValWood
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0071076 RNA 3' uridylation
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29291

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1KYVeg0GqeYxbC84WDiCzG9M9xinp8U8HP3qme17JXaM/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
   1 CACAO ~automatic transfer~  @dsiegele 
   1 FlyBase ~automatic transfer~ @hattrill 
  ~2 PomBase @ValWood~ DONE
   2 TAIR @lreiser 
 ~25 UniProt ~automatic transfer~ @Antonialock~
   1 WB ~automatic transfer~ @vanaukenk 
   4 ZFIN (plus 4 extensions) @doughowe

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv

~(actually this will be a direct replace-by GO:0031123  
RNA 3'-end processing so no action required for most but you might want to check that you have the appropriate MF term)~

Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0071076 RNA 3' uridylation

author: ValWood
body:
Apologies everyone this won't be automatic replaced-by after all.
The parentage of "RNA 3' end processing"  was incorrect. This refers to maturation, but uridylation is part of the (cytosolic) decya pathways. You will need to check which pathway and annotate appropriately.
